title: Thalamic local field potentials during reading aloud of words and nonwords (Wang et al., 2022): 11 essential tremor patients, DBS surgery (derivative: preprocessed epochs)
description: Thalamic local field potentials recorded from the ventral lateral thalamus of 11 essential tremor patients during awake deep brain stimulation (DBS) lead implantation while they read aloud consonant-vowel-consonant words and nonwords. This derivative dataset repackages the authors' preprocessed, epoched signals (notch-filtered, resampled to 1 kHz, band-limited 2-400 Hz) into BIDS iEEG format, with trial tables and MNI electrode coordinates. It supports investigation of lateralized thalamic processing of lexical status during speech production.
methods_description: Recordings were made at the University of Pittsburgh during DBS surgery, using macroelectrode rings on microelectrode mapping tracks (Alpha Omega Neuro Omega) in 4 patients and the implanted DBS lead (Medtronic 3387, Ripple Grapevine) in 7 patients. Preprocessing by the original authors included 60 Hz notch filtering, resampling to 1 kHz, 400 Hz low-pass and 2 Hz high-pass filtering, and epoching from 2 s before stimulus to 2 s after speech end. Non-re-referenced trials were written as segments of epoched BrainVision files.
